tools.name: project_inspect
tools.description: Snapshot the evaluations and project keys in the authenticated organization. Use it first to orient in an unfamiliar workspace or to resolve a projectKey. Returns evaluation summaries, a bounded count and a web link; changes nothing.

tools.name: project_plan
tools.description: Plan the next steps for connecting a repository, reviewing an evaluation, or ingesting traces. Use it when deciding what to set up next. Returns an ordered advisory step list and a web link; it never runs, writes or accepts anything.

tools.name: evaluations_list
tools.description: List the organization's evaluations, optionally filtered by lifecycle status. Use it to find an evaluationId before calling runs_list or baseline_lineage. Returns one page of evaluation summaries and a nextCursor for the following page.

tools.name: runs_list
tools.description: List the runs of one evaluation, newest first, optionally filtered by status. Use it to find a runId or check recent results and regression signals. Returns one page of run summaries and a nextCursor for the following page.

tools.name: run_explain
tools.description: Explain why one run passed or failed. Use it after runs_list when you need the failing cases and where the evidence came from. Returns the run's status, its failed cases with result metadata, an evidence-lineage summary, or not_found.

tools.name: baseline_lineage
tools.description: Show which run is the published baseline for an evaluation and where its evidence came from. Use it before comparing a new run against the baseline. Returns the baseline run and version, a lineage summary, or not_found.

tools.name: docs_search
tools.description: Search EvalGate's public REST API operations by keyword. Use it to find the right endpoint before writing an API call. Returns matching operations with method, path, summary and operationId; for product guides use the documentation MCP instead.

tools.name: connector_health
tools.description: Show the latest persisted connector-readiness reports, optionally for one connector. Use it to check whether an integration was set up and scored. Returns each report's status, score and timestamp; it is not a live credential or provider check.

tools.name: connections_list
tools.description: List the workspace's current connections with their source restrictions and freshness. Use it to see what is already connected before planning a new one. Returns connection metadata and a continuation cursor; never secrets, and it grants no source access.

tools.name: connections_catalog
tools.description: Inspect every connector definition and its exact installed setup path. Use it to choose a connector or find how to install one. Returns connector definitions with setup paths; blueprints that are unavailable and live verification are reported as separate facts.

tools.name: connections_roots
tools.description: Page through the configured account roots (top-level connected accounts) using current administrator authority. Use it to audit which accounts are configured. Returns root metadata and a continuation cursor; never secrets, and no claim that a connector works.

tools.name: connections_graph
tools.description: Read how connections link to resources: canonical connection references and the exact resource revisions currently visible. Use it to trace which source revision a connection points at. Returns references and revisions; it grants no source access and runs nothing.

tools.name: quality_contexts_list
tools.description: List the Portable Quality work contexts visible to the authenticated principal. Call this first to find a contextId and its current task revision; returns each context's id, purpose, visibility and currentTaskRevisionId.

tools.name: quality_resources_list
tools.description: List the immutable resource revisions currently attached to one visible Portable Quality context. Use it before creating a plan to pick resourceRevisionIds; returns each resource's id, revision id, slot, source kind, MIME type and content hash.

tools.name: quality_plans_list
tools.description: List the frozen Portable Quality check plans visible to the authenticated principal. Use it to find a checkPlanId to submit or reuse; returns each plan's id, task revision, manifest hash, status and requirement/resource counts.

tools.name: quality_check_get
tools.description: Get one Portable Quality check execution owned by the authenticated principal. Poll it after quality_check_submit; returns state, gate result, findings with scores and evidence, pending evidence requests and governing standards.

tools.name: quality_standards_resolve
tools.description: Resolve the approved Portable Quality standards that apply to the authenticated principal at an exact task scope and time. Call it before acting on a task to get the standards to follow; returns selected standards, inapplicable ids, conflicts and whether guidance is blocked.
